# Inter-Con Security

> > Inter-Con Security provides professional security guard services, risk consulting, and training across North America, serving healthcare, transit, non-profit, and education sectors.

Inter-Con Security is a leading security services provider operating across multiple continents, offering comprehensive solutions including access control, emergency response, workplace safety programs, and specialized training through their Peacemaker National Center. The company serves major clients including healthcare organizations like AltaMed, transit authorities such as LACMTA and DART, and critical infrastructure including airports.

## Key Topics

- Security Guards & Officers
- Access Control Systems
- Risk Assessment & Consulting
- Emergency Preparedness & Response
- Healthcare Security (HIPAA-compliant)
- Transit & Transportation Security
- Workplace Safety Programs
- Security Training & Certification
- Physical Security Operations
- Business Continuity Planning
- COVID-19 Screening Services
- Active Shooter Prevention
- De-escalation Techniques
- CPR/AED Certification
